data.body: Research note (session 2026-05-17, see docs/findings/code-review-fp-research-2026-05-17.md): The published consensus on FP-reduction-system metrics differs from precision/recall/F1 in ways that affect this epic's M2 query schema. (1) Balanced Accuracy (Youden's J statistic; arXiv 2512.08121) is prevalence-independent and recommended over F1 for tuning judge/verifier systems where class prevalence shifts over time. (2) FPR_P and FPR_R (false-positive-reduction precision/recall — arXiv 2601.18844 Datadog industrial deployment) measure precision and recall *for the FP class itself*, which is the right denominator when the goal is reducing FPs rather than maximizing finding recall. Recommendation: add Balanced Accuracy and FPR_P/FPR_R to the 'query rule-effectiveness <rule-id>' subcommand output (SC3) alongside any conventional metrics. Cost: small math additions to calibration-report.sh; large analytical payoff for downstream rule pruning.
